arguments.Title: Check protocol 4 observation
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using System.IO; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) {var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); if(c==null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.LatestObservationJson)){result.Log("NOT_READY");return;} File.WriteAllText("artifacts/high_speed_drive/protocol4-observation.json",c.LatestObservationJson); result.Log("connected="+c.Connected+" status="+c.Status+" reason="+c.DiagnosticReason); } }
